items.title: Public comments; The District has adopted a policy regarding public comment. A copy of this policy will be available at the meeting. All those wishing to address the Board during the public comment period shall indicate a desire to address the Board on the applicable sign-in sheets provided. Public comments are limited to three (3) minutes per person for a total of thirty (30) minutes
